title: ComfyUI — WAN 2.2 S2V Audio-to-Video
description: Generate talking-head videos from a reference image and audio file using WAN 2.2 S2V 14B. Accepts an image URL and audio URL, produces a lip-synced video uploaded to your RunPod S3 bucket. All models are auto-downloaded on first cold start (~25 GB) — no manual setup required.

input.name: S3 Endpoint URL
input.description: RunPod S3-compatible endpoint for uploading output videos

input.name: S3 Bucket Name
input.description: Bucket name within your RunPod S3 for storing generated videos

input.name: S3 Access Key ID
input.description: RunPod S3 access key for uploading outputs (leave empty for public buckets)

input.name: S3 Secret Access Key
input.description: RunPod S3 secret key for uploading outputs (leave empty for public buckets)

input.name: ComfyUI Log Level
input.description: Log level for ComfyUI (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR)

input.name: Model Volume Path
input.description: Path to a RunPod network volume with pre-downloaded models. Leave empty to auto-download models inside the container on first cold start.
